title: Kissed Savory Brazilian Sea Bass Skewers
description: A savory and snappy Brazilian dish featuring sea bass fillets, poached to perfection on a cedar plank, with a blend of monsoon Brazilian flavors. This low-sodium-friendly recipe is perfect for a dinner party.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, and paprika.
Place the sea bass fillets on the soaked cedar planks.
Brush the lime juice mixture evenly over both sides of the sea bass fillets.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Place the cedar planks on the grill and cook for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the fish is cooked through.
Remove the sea bass from the grill and let it rest for 2 minutes.
Serve the sea bass hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and lime wedges.
